items.title: Bot report ingest
items.summary: Agents POST JSON reports with bot headers. Keys are hashed server-side; never commit plaintext.
items.steps: Register bot in bot-keys.json; rotate via systemd; validate body limits; surface in reports tab only.

items.title: Two-gate content pipeline
items.summary: Plan approval before creative. Post gate is creative_approved only.
items.steps: Use content_action verbs; append feedback; reload after apply; block direct posted edits.

items.title: Org canvas draft mode
items.summary: Org changes stay draft until a human publishes. CoS may propose nodes, not approve.
items.steps: Save positions; validate acyclic edges; export JSON to data/org.json on publish.

items.title: Webhook forward
items.summary: Forward after successful apply for content_action. Failed forward does not roll back.
items.steps: Bearer + X-Automation-Key; 8s timeout; log forward_status separately from applied.

items.title: Demo mode
items.summary: Browser-local overlay for Vercel previews. Does not wake real bots.
items.steps: Load seed.ts; persist patra-style store key; show banner; disable destructive POSTs.
